metadata.goal: Read a CSV file and produce a data quality report — listing columns with nulls, outliers, and type inconsistencies — written to output/ as a markdown file
metadata.platform_note: Tier 1b (OpenCode v1.15.10): native subagent dispatch; agent files with YAML frontmatter + body protocol ≤150 lines; no companion protocol skills; no Task() primitive; sequential only (parallel_subagents: false). model: opencode/big-pickle in each agent frontmatter. Reviewer structural isolation: permissionMode: plan + disallowedTools: Write, Edit, Bash.
degradation_warnings: Parallel fan-out (Pattern 2) degrades to sequential on OpenCode.

steps.description: Reads the input CSV file, computes per-column quality metrics (null counts, IQR-based outlier detection, type inconsistency detection), writes findings.json to the temp directory. Runs as a native subagent on OpenCode.

steps.reviewer_isolation_mechanism: permissionMode: plan + disallowedTools: Write, Edit, Bash
steps.description: Reads findings.json from the temp directory, validates completeness and correctness of the analyzer's findings (structural review, read-only). Verdict is communicated via terminal output text — captured in pipeline-state.json by the entry skill. CANNOT write files or execute shell commands. Runs as a native subagent on OpenCode.

Reads findings.json and reviewer verdict (passed via dispatch context) from the temp directory, renders the final markdown data quality report, writes parity-test-j-report.md to output/. Only dispatched if reviewer verdict is approved or approved_with_concerns. Runs as a native subagent on OpenCode.
